metaDescription: The best 200 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Rishikesh RYS200 Yoga Alliance USA. You will develop competency in the fundamentals of Hatha Yoga and Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga, improve your meditation abilities, and learn about successful pranayama methods.
summary: A month-long 200 hour programme in Rishikesh covering the fundamentals of Hatha Yoga and Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga, meditation, pranayama, philosophy and anatomy.
intro: Our month-long program welcomes aspiring teachers and dedicated practitioners seeking to enhance their knowledge of yoga.

You will develop competency in the fundamentals of Hatha Yoga and Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga, improve your meditation abilities, and learn about successful pranayama methods. Our experienced teachers in Rishikesh make difficult concepts easier, building your confidence in both your practice and teaching abilities. Throughout the training, you will also be taught vital pranayama techniques, engage in meditation practices, and explore the fascinating elements of yoga philosophy and anatomy.

You will acquire more than just postures – we will show you how to create engaging classes, understand proper positioning, and guide your prospective students with compassion. Our philosophy sessions apply ancient wisdom to the current world by situating it within a modern framework. Additionally, once you have finished obtaining your Yoga Alliance certification, you will be able to teach yoga in any part of the globe.
During your time here, you will discover how to arrange classes, refine adjustment methods, and develop your personal teaching approach.
